pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Vesāliyaṃ paṇītānaṃ bhattānaṃ bhattapaṭipāṭi adhiṭṭhitā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.3: atha kho aññatarassa daliddassa kammakārassa etad ahosi: na kho idaṃ orakaṃ bhavissati yatha yime manussā sakkaccaṃ bhattaṃ karonti. yaṃ nūnāhaṃ pi bhattaṃ kareyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.4: atha kho so daliddo kammakāro yena Kirapatiko ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ Kirapatikaṃ etad avoca: icchām' ahaṃ ayyaputta buddhapamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa bhattaṃ kātuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.6: so pi kho Kirapatiko saddho hoti pasanno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.7: atha kho so Kirapatiko tassa daliddassa kammakārassa abbhatirekaṃ vetanaṃ adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.8: atha kho so daliddo kammakāro yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so daliddo kammakāro bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.9: adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.12: bahū me badarā paṭiyattā, badaramissena peyyā paripūrissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.14: atha kho so daliddo kammakāro bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.15: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū: daliddena kira kammakārena svātanāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṃgho nimantito badaramissena peyyā paripūrissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.16: te kālass' eva piṇḍāya caritvā bhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.17: assosuṃ kho manussā daliddena kira kammakārena buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṃgho nimantito 'ti. te daliddassa kammakārassa bahukaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ abhihariṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.18: atha kho so daliddo kammakāro tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: kālo bhante niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.19: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena tassa daliddassa kammakārassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.20: atha kho so daliddo kammakāro bhattagge bhikkhū parivisati. bhikkhū evam āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.21: thokaṃ āvuso dehi thokaṃ āvuso dehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.22: mā kho tumhe bhante ayaṃ daliddo kammakāro 'ti thokaṃ thokaṃ paṭigaṇhittha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.25: na kho mayaṃ āvuso etaṃkāraṇā thokaṃ thokaṃ paṭigaṇhāma,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.26: api ca mayaṃ kālass' eva piṇḍāya caritvā bhuñjimhā, tena mayaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ paṭigaṇhāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.27: atha kho so daliddo kammakāro ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.28: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā mayā nimantitā aññatra bhuñjissanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.29: na cāhaṃ paṭibalo yāvadatthaṃ dātun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.30: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa daliddassa kammakārassa . . . vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.32: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū aññatra nimantitā aññatra bhuñjissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.33: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū aññatra nimantitā aññatra bhuñjantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.36: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā . . . bhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.40: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.2: aññataro bhikkhu piṇḍapātaṃ ādāya yena so bhikkhu ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca: bhuñjāhi āvuso 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.4: tassa bhikkhuno piṇḍapāto ussūre āhariyittha. so bhikkhu na cittarūpaṃ bhuñji.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā paraṃparabhojanaṃ bhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.8: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.10: tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.11: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā cīvaradānasamaye sacīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhikkhū nimantenti bhojetvā cīvarena acchādessāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.16: tatthāyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.17: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||3||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya āyasmatā Ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena aññataraṃ kulaṃ ten' upasaṃkami,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.2: upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. atha kho te manussā bhagavato ca āyasmato ca Ānandassa bhojanaṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.9: evañ ca pana bhikkhave vikappetabbaṃ: mayhaṃ bhattapaccāsaṃ itthannāmassa dammīti. ||4||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.1.2: pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññatarena bhojanena nimantito, taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññataraṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati, etaṃ paraṃparabhojanaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.1.6: na sakkoti ekāsane nisinno yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjituṃ, gilānasamayo 'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.3.6: sakalena gāmena nimantito tasmiṃ gāme yattha katthaci bhuñjati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.3.7: sakalena pūgena nimantito tasmiṃ pūge yattha katthaci bhuñjati,
